scientific_question: Locate additional evidence suitable for a whole-source test of late decline without reusing known outcomes as prospective evidence.

development.ledger_eligibility: Staged 3E GCD endpoints at least 5000 cycles and at most 80% retention; exact P31 three-electrode source absent. Audit all returned ledger identities, at most six highest-priority unique source families for original evidence. Prefer at least one open local original; sort by known cycling current first, then lower retention and DOI. Previously reviewed ineligible sources stay logged; no bypass.
development.binding: Same tested sample, GCD current and electrode system, at least three distinct positive early observations wholly within approved 10% or 20% horizon, and defensible long-cycle author or graph evidence. Preserve source wording, uncertainty and conflicts separately.

blind.query_template: (TITLE:supercapacitor OR TITLE:supercapacitors OR TITLE:"electrochemical capacitor") AND (TITLE:"porous carbon" OR TITLE:"activated carbon" OR TITLE:"carbon electrode" OR TITLE:"carbon electrodes") AND ({precursor_title_terms}) AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y AND IN_PMC:Y AND HAS_PDF:Y AND FIRST_PDATE:[2020-01-01 TO 2026-11-06]
blind.triage: Newest first by publication date, then DOI. Require DOI and PMCID and named original biomass carbon in title; reject reviews, corrections, titles disclosing numeric cycling outcomes, non-biomass precursors, and explicit mixed-phase devices or non-supercapacitor tasks. Exclude exact DOI or normalized title matches in tracked project text and both live source catalogs. Preserve all exclusion counts.
blind.exposure: Bibliographic metadata only until candidate identities are separately frozen. After freeze, automated structure-only screening may cache original XML and emit flags, IDs and counts without captions, figures, endpoints, or absolute terminal quantities. Verify lineage and masked early observations separately before locking predictions.
